name: Shikura Bansai
source:
Specialty: Making puppets
Hobby: Making puppets
Likes: Making puppets
Dislikes: Puppet commission

A houseboy student who lives in the second floor of a worn-out tenement house, whose hobby is making puppets. Most of them are impractical and there are many junk whose usage are unknown, but it seems that Bansai intended to make a big invention. He's doing things in his own pace that amazed people around him.

"Ahaha, air isn't something you read, though? 
More importantly, look at the my newest creation! It's my masterpiece!"
